title: First-variation control of a scaled restricted measure gives locally bounded first variation and a bound on ‖δW‖
statement: Let Ω ⊆ ℝ^N, μ a measure on ℝ^N × G(N,n), W an n-varifold on Ω, and c, β ∈ [0,∞] with c ≠ ∞ and β ≠ ∞, such that W.measure = c • μ⌞(Ω × G(N,n)). Assume that for every C¹ field X : ℝ^N → ℝ^N with compact support, tsupport X ⊆ Ω and ‖X(y)‖ ≤ 1 for all y, we have ofReal|∫ div_S X(z) dμ(z,S)| ≤ β, where div_S X(z) = Varifold.tangentialDivergence X z S. Then W has locally bounded first variation, and variationMeasure W O ≤ c·β for every O with IsRelCompactOpenIn O Ω.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (W : Varifold N n Ω) (c β : ℝ≥0∞), c ≠ ∞ → β ≠ ∞ → W.measure = c • μ.restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → (∀ X : Euclidean N → Euclidean N, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ Ω → (∀ y, ‖X y‖ ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ z, Varifold.tangentialDivergence X z.1 z.2 ∂μ| ≤ β) → W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation ∧ ∀ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsRelCompactOpenIn O Ω → variationMeasure W O ≤ c * β
